question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract for third-party producers, or should this Slack/Codex fix use a narrower non-public seam?
rationale: The repository treats Plugin SDK additions as compatibility-sensitive permanent API, and the discussion contains no maintainer approval establishing this new cross-plugin contract's long-term semantics.

options.title: Approve and document the generic contract
options.body: Keep one stable marker and predicate with explicit producer eligibility, required channel behavior, and compatibility coverage.

options.title: Use a narrower seam
options.body: Avoid expanding the third-party SDK and carry the intent only through approved bundled owner paths.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep one stable marker and predicate with explicit producer eligibility, required channel behavior, and compatibility coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history ties Peter Steinberger to the Slack delivery consumer boundary where this public contract is interpreted.
